name: bridge-gui
description: XRift Bridge の管理画面（Electrobun によるデスクトップ GUI。段1スパイク）。

scripts.gui:run: hutch electrobun build --env=dev && hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:run:ng: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && hutch electrobun build --env=dev && BRIDGE_GUI_VIEW=mainview-ng hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:run:ng:debug: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && hutch electrobun build --env=dev && BRIDGE_GUI_VIEW=mainview-ng BRIDGE_GUI_NG_DEBUG=1 hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:build:ng: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:prod && hutch run build
